job_title: Resident Emotional Healing Counselor / Psychologist at Wellness Resort in Dehadun
job_description:
You are applying for the position of Resident Emotional Healing Counselor / Psychologist at Wellness Resort in Dehadun

Please read carefully. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Preferred Eligibility Criteria
• Degree: Master’s Degree in Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or equivalent mental health qualification from a recognized institution.
• Certifications: Completed multiple certifications in emotional wellness, trauma resolution, somatic therapy, mindfulness, or expressive arts healing.
• Experience: Minimum 3–5+ years of experience conducting 1-on-1 counseling, group facilitation, and designing/executing mental health retreats (preferably in luxury wellness or retreat environments).
• Location & Lifestyle: Full-time, on-site resident role. Must reside on the sanctuary grounds (complete 24-hour executive accommodation and food provided).

Role Details
• Designation: Resident Emotional Healing Counselor & Retreat Lead
• Location: Om Kalyanam Santhigiri Sanctuary (On-site)
• Type: Full-time Resident Role
• Accommodation: Luxury on-site 24-hour food and executive accommodation provided
• Perks & Benefits: Comprehensive medical insurance, wellness perks, performance-linked bonuses, and access to pristine living amenities
• Salary Range: ₹35,000 to ₹50,000++ per month (Commensurate with experience and caliber)

Job Description
• 1-on-1 Consultations: Conduct private, deep emotional healing and psychological counseling sessions for high-achieving guests, CEOs, and families facing burnout or decision fatigue.
• Group Facilitation: Lead high-trust, confidential group conversations, workshops, and emotional unburdening circles.
• Retreat Design & Delivery: Conceptualize, curate, and facilitate signature emotional healing retreats targeting cognitive quiet, stress release, and trauma resolution.
• Somatic & Vagal Integration: Combine psychological techniques with somatic therapies to help guests release stored emotional tension from their nervous system.
• Multi-Disciplinary Coordination: Work alongside the Chief Ayurveda Physician and Quantum Healing teams to ensure a unified approach to Mind (Sukshma) health.

Must-Have Skills & Qualities
• Strong repertoire of completed courses in mental health, emotional wellness, somatic work, or trauma-informed therapy.
• Exceptional emotional intelligence, empathy, and high-level interpersonal skills to handle sensitive topics with elite clientele.
• Proven ability to design and lead engaging group workshops and transformative multi-day retreats.
• Fluency in English and Hindi.
• Strong understanding of decision fatigue, executive burnout, and modern neuro-psychological stress patterns.

Your Growth CurveAt Om Kalyanam Santhigiri, growth is aligned with clinical excellence, guest transformation, and leadership.
• Opportunity to lead and build the Mental Clarity & Emotional Healing division at a world-class sanctuary.
• Direct involvement in creating pioneer retreat models combining Eastern mind-traditions with Western psychology.
• Platform to author wellness content, lead global workshops, and represent the brand internationally.

Please Note
• A resident counselor role at a luxury sanctuary demands absolute confidentiality, deep empathy, operational agility, and emotional resilience.

How to Apply

Send the following to info@omkalyanam.com:
• Your updated CV/Resume
• Copies of your Master's degree and relevant therapeutic certifications
• Answers to these four questions in the email body:
• How many years of experience do you have in 1-on-1 counseling, group facilitation, and retreat design?
• Are you comfortable residing full-time on-site with 24-hour food and executive accommodation provided?
• What is your current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period?
• This is an urgent hiring. Can you join within 20 days of selection?

Subject line: Application for Resident Emotional Healing Counselor
